description: Query public SBA 7(a) FOIA Change-of-Ownership loan aggregates by NAICS code, US state, and loan size. Separates trailing 24-month active acquisition approvals from seasoned FY2018-FY2021 charge-off cohorts, reporting sample size n and suppressing charge-off counts, dollars, and percentages when n < 10. Contains zero borrower PII.

limit.description: Maximum number of lenders to return (1 to 25, default 10).
limit.title: Limit

loan_amount.description: Estimated SBA 7(a) loan amount in USD (up to $5,000,000).
loan_amount.title: Loan Amount

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. 'TX') or full state name (e.g. 'Texas').
state.title: State

name: find_sba_acquisition_lenders
title: Find active SBA 7(a) acquisition lenders & charge-offs
